shape: some people feel like a cosy everyday comparison

slides.text: some people feel like the back gate: ten years later, you don't knock, you just [[walk right into the kitchen]].

caption:
we don't even talk every month anymore.
but the second we pick up, we are right back sitting on the counter.
send this to the best friend who never had to ring your front doorbell.

#bestfriendquotes #childhoodfriends #longdistancefriendship
